companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text: Bosch was founded in Stuttgart in 1886 by Robert Bosch (1861-1942) and for more than 130 years has been distinguished by a unique corporate culture based on solid values that drive us to improve every day. Our products, present in a wide variety of fields, that contribute to improve the quality of life of millions of people.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text: The Technical Project Manager acts as the technical counterpart to the Project Manager and is responsible to plan, coordinate and execute global multi-disciplinary engineering activities to achieve project success. Responsible for making sure the technical team understands and fulfills the customer and internal requirements on specification, on schedule and on budget.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Required skills:

  • Project management: stakeholder management, schedule management, risk management, resource management, quality management
  • Excellent communication, assertiveness, ability to negotiate and convey complex abstract ideas to global teams and OEMs
  • Organizational awareness and development of relationships
  • Leadership
  • Task prioritization
  • Decision making
  • Goal-oriented mindset
  • Capable to work independently in an organized and structured fashion
  • Problem solving abilities

Required experience:

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text: Travel required approximately 5% of the time within Mexico or USA
